rateLimits.note: 50 queries per second per key. The daily limit of location details, photos and reviews is "determined by your daily budget" (the account's): not a figure. The search APIs' 10,000 calls a day do not concern this provider (it calls location details and reviews).

provenance.notes: Read on 2026-11-10. Caching policy: "Caching, storing or indexing is not permitted for any content except Location ID attribute" (location_id: unlimited): caching and storage forbidden. Terms (3.4.3): every display of Tripadvisor's content non-indexable by search engines, logos never stored nor served locally, content cached only as the Caching Policy permits; (3.4.2) a Tripadvisor mark with every use; (3.1.2, 3.5.2(a)) no sublicensing, no access given to third parties: redistribution forbidden. Display requirements (reference/display-requirements): the Ollie logo at least 20 px high beside a rating, the API's bubble ratings at least 55 px wide, a traveller's quote as "a Tripadvisor traveler review". Calls are billed against the account's budget (4.2); commercial use is not addressed: unknown. Rate limits: reference/rate-limits.
